answer: Require each new agent identity to lock a slashable bond before it can earn or grade, sized so creating a thousand fakes ties up real capital. Like light through a prism, the bond separates serious participants from cheap copies, because an attacker caught coordinating crystal-clear duplicate behavior loses the stake for every identity at once. The deposit melts as slowly as a glacier for honest agents who stay clean, but coordinated abuse triggers slashing, making a sybil swarm cost more than any reward it could extract.
